headline: Yemeni government claims 'Dawn of Yemen' offensive
dek: 780 targeted operations against Ansar Allah fighters in 24 hours as part of the 'Dawn of Yemen' offensive — ATTRIBUTED REPORT / single-source claim, independently unverified. Audiences treat the number as propaganda (social evidence: mockery, 'fabricated victories').
fault_line: The Yemen government claims 780 strikes against Ansar Allah fighters in 24 hours — real battlefield victories, or made-up numbers for social media?

sections.what_happened: 780 targeted operations against Ansar Allah fighters in 24 hours as part of the 'Dawn of Yemen' offensive — ATTRIBUTED REPORT / single-source claim, independently unverified. Audiences treat the number as propaganda (social evidence: mockery, 'fabricated victories').
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog recap only. No UN, wire or independent battlefield confirmation at scan time.
sections.what_disputed: No independent casualty/territorial evidence; Ansar Allah launched a ballistic missile toward Riyadh the same night (0600-01) — inconsistent with an offensive crippling their capabilities. Both sides' strike/body counts are routinely mocked online.
